title: Capacity Sentinel
user: Teams calling one or more model APIs who need early, vendor-neutral evidence of capacity errors, latency regressions, and output-shape degradation before users report failures.
smallest_useful_product: A self-hostable probe runner that sends user-supplied synthetic canaries, records status/latency/validated JSON invariants, and emits vendor-neutral SLO alerts.
success_measure: A pilot detects injected 429 and latency failures within two probe intervals and attributes the affected provider/model with 95% accuracy.
monetization: freemium — a local single-project runner stays free while managed probe locations and retention are paid.
constraints: Synthetic prompts only by default; strict API-key encryption; configurable cost caps; do not claim universal semantic-quality measurement.
